const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const req = $json.requirements_extract || {};
const tenderId = $json.tender_id;
const lines = [
`# Go/No-Go Pack`,
`Tender_ID: ${tenderId}`,
``,
`## 3-line scope`,
req.scope_summary_3_lines || 'UNKNOWN',
``,
`## Design maturity`,
req.design_maturity || 'Unknown (no evidence)',
``,
`## Contract risks`,
JSON.stringify(req.contract_risks || [], null, 2),
``,
`## Risk tier`,
String(req.recommended_risk_tier || 'UNKNOWN'),
``,
`## Top operational risks`,
JSON.stringify((req.top_operational_risks || []).slice(0,3), null, 2),
``,
`## Recommendation`,
req.recommended_go || 'Go_with_Conditions',
``,
`## Conditions`,
JSON.stringify(req.go_conditions || [], null, 2),
``,
`## RFI summary`,
`Count: ${(req.missing_information || []).length}`,
`Next action after Go: send RFIs immediately`
];
const outDir = path.join($json.tender_root, '04_Go_NoGo_Pack');
fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'go_nogo_pack.md'), lines.join('
'), 'utf-8');
return [{json: $json}];
